description: AI customer case study (grounded) — Turns raw customer-story notes into a B2B case study: title, summary, customer profile, challenge, solution, results, metric callouts and call to action. Built to not invent facts: every number in the output is checked offline against your notes (numbersNotInNotes, verdict GROUNDED/REVIEW) and any quote not present in the notes is removed. Optional: customer, product, style. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

notes.description: e.g. Acme Logistics, 120 trucks, manual dispatch on spreadsheets, switched to RouteIQ in March, on-time deliveries went from 82% to 96%, saved 14 dispatcher hours a week

name: ai_case_study
